For people who work from cafés, coworking spaces and hotel desks: a full-size keyboard you can actually carry.

The ProtoArc XK01 has 105 keys including a number pad and tri-folds to 8.46 x 4.68 in (10.5 oz). It switches between 3 devices over Bluetooth 5.1, so the same keyboard works with a laptop, tablet and phone. Bluetooth only, no USB receiver.

$39.99 on sale (reg. $53.99, as of Sep 29), and code GFPHOANGNONGVAN takes an extra 10% off at ProtoArc.com. Details in the first comment.
